text: Proog and Emo enter a complex mechanical world as Proog begins guiding the journey.
Proog gives Emo a telephone lesson about listening to the machine's internal rhythms.
Proog demonstrates the clockwork precision of the industrial world while Emo remains skeptical.
The two characters enter a dark void where Emo struggles to perceive the nothingness Proog describes.
They encounter the forbidden SERVICE OFFICE door, and Proog orders Emo not to enter.
After Proog's refusal, the story cuts to a room with a large fan as the tension escalates.
Emo rebels against Proog's vision, causing the mechanical world to begin breaking apart.
The environment shatters into a golden chaotic void as Proog confronts the consequences of Emo's defiance.
The confrontation ends with defeated Emo on the ground as the world settles into a quiet final state.
Closing credits roll after the Elephant Dreams story ends.
